dog.description_text:
With his stunning yellow eyes and soft expression, Toby has a way of looking right at you like he’s hoping you might be his person. He isn’t the loud, center-of-attention type—instead, he’s the cat who will sit beside you, keep you company, and remind you how special the quiet moments can be.

Toby does have some special medical needs, but he takes his medications like an absolute champ. With a simple routine and a caring home, he’s ready to live a happy, comfortable life.

Everyone who meets Toby can see there’s something special about him. He’s the kind of cat who forms a deep bond with his person—the kind of companion you remember forever.

If you’re looking for a gentle, loving soul to share your home and heart, Toby might just be that once-in-a-lifetime cat.
